known_pitfalls.claim: Coherent intensities simply add at every point.
known_pitfalls.correction: Amplitudes superpose first, producing an interference term in intensity.
It is interference among wavelets from different parts of an aperture.

known_pitfalls.claim: Longitudinal waves can be plane polarised like light.
known_pitfalls.correction: Polarisation is characteristic of transverse waves.
